1→# ozaMenu - Dijital QR Menu ve Fiyat Defteri Platformu
     2→
     3→[![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-15.5-black?logo=next.js)](https://nextjs.org/)
     4→[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.7-blue?logo=typescript)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/)
     5→[![Supabase](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supabase-PostgreSQL-green?logo=supabase)](https://supabase.com/)
     6→[![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-4.x-38B2AC?logo=tailwind-css)](https://tailwindcss.com/)
     7→
     8→**Turkiye'deki restoran, kafe ve benzeri isletmeler icin Ticaret Bakanligi regulasyonlarina uyumlu Dijital Fiyat Defteri ve QR Menu SaaS platformu.**
     9→
    10→## Icindekiler
    11→
    12→- [Proje Hakkinda](#proje-hakkinda)
    13→- [Ozellikler](#ozellikler)
    14→- [Teknoloji Yigini](#teknoloji-yigini)
    15→- [On Kosullar](#on-kosullar)
    16→- [Kurulum](#kurulum)
    17→- [Ortam Degiskenleri](#ortam-degiskenleri)
    18→- [Veritabani Kurulumu](#veritabani-kurulumu)
    19→- [Gelistirme](#gelistirme)
    20→- [Test](#test)
    21→- [Proje Yapisi](#proje-yapisi)
    22→- [Paket Ozellikleri](#paket-ozellikleri)
    23→- [Deployment](#deployment)
    24→- [Mimari Kararlar](#mimari-kararlar)
    25→- [Katki](#katki)
    26→- [Lisans](#lisans)
    27→
    28→---
    29→
    30→## Proje Hakkinda
    31→
    32→ozaMenu, isletmelerin dijital menuleri yonetmelerini saglayan, hukuki uyumlu bir SaaS platformudur. Platform, sadece gorsel bir menu degil, **yasal olarak gecerli, denetlenebilir ve degismez fiyat kaydi tutan** bir sistemdir.
    33→
    34→### Temel Avantajlar
    35→
    36→- **Hukuki Uyumluluk**: Ticaret Bakanligi regulasyonlarina uygun fiyat defteri
    37→- **Degismez Kayit**: Fiyat degisiklikleri INSERT-only pattern ile saklanir, UPDATE/DELETE yasak
    38→- **Multi-Tenant Mimari**: Her isletme sadece kendi verisine erisebilir (RLS ile korunur)
    39→- **Masa Bazli QR**: Musterinin hangi masada oturdugu bilinir, garson bildirimleri
    40→- **Dinamik Paket Yonetimi**: Hard-coded limit yok, tum ozellikler veritabanindan yonetilir
    41→
    42→---
    43→
    44→## Ozellikler
    45→
    46→### Temel Ozellikler
    47→
    48→| Ozellik | Aciklama |
    49→|---------|----------|
    50→| Degismez Fiyat Defteri | Tum fiyat degisiklikleri tarihce olarak saklanir, hukuki kanit niteliginde |
    51→| Multi-Tenant Izolasyon | RLS politikalari ile isletmeler arasi veri izolasyonu |
    52→| Dinamik Feature Flags | Paket ozellikleri veritabanindan yonetilir, kod degisikligi gerektirmez |
    53→| Masa QR Sistemi | Her masaya ozel QR kod, musteri takibi |
    54→| Realtime Garson Bildirimleri | Supabase Realtime ile anlik bildirimler |
    55→| SHA-256 Menu Snapshot | Her fiyat degisikliginde menu durumu hash'lenir |
    56→| RBAC Yetkilendirme | Owner, Admin, Manager, Waiter, Viewer rolleri |
    57→
    58→### Panel Ozellikleri
    59→
    60→- **Merchant Paneli**: Urun, kategori, masa yonetimi, fiyat guncelleme
    61→- **Super Admin Paneli**: Isletme aktivasyonu, paket yonetimi, ozel izinler
    62→- **Garson Paneli**: Realtime servis talepleri, masa durumu
    63→- **Audit Log**: Tum islemlerin denetim kaydi
    64→
    65→---
    66→
    67→## Teknoloji Yigini
    68→
    69→### Frontend
    70→| Teknoloji | Versiyon | Aciklama |
    71→|-----------|----------|----------|
    72→| Next.js | 15.5.x | React framework (App Router) |
    73→| TypeScript | 5.7.x | Tip guvenli JavaScript |
    74→| Tailwind CSS | 4.x | Utility-first CSS framework |
    75→| React | 19.x | UI kutuphanesi |
    76→
    77→### Backend & Veritabani
    78→| Teknoloji | Aciklama |
    79→|-----------|----------|
    80→| Supabase | PostgreSQL, Auth, Realtime, Storage |
    81→| PostgreSQL | Iliskisel veritabani |
    82→| Row Level Security | Veri izolasyonu |
    83→
    84→### Araclar
    85→| Arac | Aciklama |
    86→|------|----------|
    87→| Vitest | Test framework |
    88→| ESLint | Kod kalitesi |
    89→| QRCode | QR kod uretimi |
    90→
    91→---
    92→
    93→## On Kosullar
    94→
    95→Projeyi calistirmadan once asagidakilerin kurulu olmasi gerekmektedir:
    96→
    97→1. **Node.js** >= 20.9
    98→   ```bash
    99→   # Node.js versiyonunu kontrol edin
   100→   node --version
   101→
   102→   # nvm kullaniyorsaniz
   103→   nvm install 20
   104→   nvm use 20
   105→   ```
   106→
   107→2. **npm** veya **pnpm**
   108→   ```bash
   109→   npm --version
   110→   ```
   111→
   112→3. **Supabase Hesabi**
   113→   - [supabase.com](https://supabase.com) adresinden ucretsiz hesap olusturun
   114→   - Yeni bir proje olusturun
   115→
   116→4. **Git**
   117→   ```bash
   118→   git --version
   119→   ```
   120→
   121→---
   122→
   123→## Kurulum
   124→
   125→### 1. Repoyu Klonlama
   126→
   127→```bash
   128→git clone https://github.com/your-org/ozon-qr-menu.git
   129→cd ozon-qr-menu
   130→```
   131→
   132→### 2. Bagimliliklari Yukleme
   133→
   134→```bash
   135→npm install
   136→```
   137→
   138→### 3. Ortam Degiskenlerini Ayarlama
   139→
   140→```bash
   141→# Ornek dosyayi kopyalayin
   142→cp .env.local.example .env.local
   143→
   144→# Dosyayi duzenleyin ve Supabase bilgilerinizi girin
   145→nano .env.local  # veya tercih ettiginiz editoru kullanin
   146→```
   147→
   148→### 4. Veritabani Migrasyonlarini Calistirma
   149→
   150→Supabase Dashboard uzerinden veya Supabase CLI ile migrasyonlari calistirin:
   151→
   152→```bash
   153→# Supabase CLI kurulumu (opsiyonel)
   154→npm install -g supabase
   155→
   156→# Local Supabase baslat (opsiyonel - gelistirme icin)
   157→npx supabase start
   158→
   159→# Migrasyonlari uygula
   160→npx supabase db push
   161→```
   162→
   163→Manuel olarak Supabase Dashboard > SQL Editor uzerinden de calistirabilirsiniz:
   164→1. `supabase/migrations/` klasorundeki dosyalari sirayla calistirin
   165→2. `supabase/seed.sql` dosyasini calistirarak baslangic verisini ekleyin
   166→
   167→### 5. Gelistirme Sunucusunu Baslatma
   168→
   169→```bash
   170→npm run dev
   171→```
   172→
   173→Uygulama [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) adresinde calisacaktir.
   174→
   175→---
   176→
   177→## Ortam Degiskenleri
   178→
   179→`.env.local` dosyasinda asagidaki degiskenleri tanimlayin:
   180→
   181→```env
   182→# Supabase Project URL
   183→# Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API > Project URL
   184→NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project-ref.supabase.co
   185→
   186→# Supabase Anonymous (Public) Key
   187→# Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API > Project API keys > anon public
   188→# Bu anahtar client-side'da guvenle kullanilabilir (RLS ile korunur)
   189→NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-anon-key-here
   190→
   191→# Supabase Service Role Key (GIZLI - ASLA CLIENT'A EXPOSE ETME!)
   192→# Supabase Dashboard > Settings > API > Project API keys > service_role
   193→# Bu anahtar RLS'i bypass eder, sadece server-side'da kullanin
   194→SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=your-service-role-key-here
   195→```
   196→
   197→### Ortam Degiskenlerini Bulma
   198→
   199→1. [Supabase Dashboard](https://supabase.com/dashboard) adresine gidin
   200→2. Projenizi secin
   201→3. **Settings** > **API** bolumune gidin
   202→4. Asagidaki degerleri kopyalayin:
   203→   - **Project URL** → `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`
   204→   - **anon public** → `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
   205→   - **service_role** → `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`
   206→
   207→> **UYARI**: `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` anahtarini asla client-side kodunda kullanmayin veya Git'e commit etmeyin!
   208→
   209→---
   210→
   211→## Veritabani Kurulumu
   212→
   213→### Migrasyon Dosyalari
   214→
   215→Veritabani semasi asagidaki migrasyon dosyalariyla olusturulur:
   216→
   217→| Dosya | Aciklama |
   218→|-------|----------|
   219→| `001_core_tables.sql` | Organizations, members, categories tablolari |
   220→| `002_products_price_ledger.sql` | Products ve immutable price_ledger |
   221→| `003_package_management.sql` | Features, plans, subscriptions |
   222→| `004_tables_service_requests.sql` | Masa ve garson sistemi |
   223→| `005_audit_compliance.sql` | Menu snapshots ve audit logs |
   224→| `006_views.sql` | current_prices ve diger view'lar |
   225→| `007_rls_policies.sql` | Row Level Security politikalari |
   226→| `010_auto_snapshot_trigger.sql` | Otomatik snapshot trigger'i |
   227→
   228→### Seed Data
   229→
   230→`supabase/seed.sql` dosyasi asagidaki baslangic verisini icerir:
   231→
   232→- **Features Katalogu**: 27 farkli ozellik tanimlamasi
   233→- **Paket Tanimlari**: Lite, Pro, Premium paketleri
   234→- **Paket-Ozellik Eslesmeleri**: Her paketin hangi ozelliklere sahip oldugu
   235→
   236→### Migrasyonlari Elle Calistirma
   237→
   238→Supabase Dashboard > SQL Editor'de sirayla:
   239→
   240→```sql
   241→-- Her dosyayi sirayla kopyalayip calistirin
   242→-- 1. supabase/migrations/001_core_tables.sql
   243→-- 2. supabase/migrations/002_products_price_ledger.sql
   244→-- ... devam edin
   245→-- Son olarak seed.sql dosyasini calistirin
   246→```
   247→
   248→---
   249→
   250→## Gelistirme
   251→
   252→### Kullanilabilir Komutlar
   253→
   254→```bash
   255→# Gelistirme sunucusu
   256→npm run dev
   257→
   258→# Production build
   259→npm run build
   260→

   262→npm start

   278→
   279→# Coverage raporu
   280→npm run test:coverage
   281→
   282→# Test UI
   283→npm run test:ui
   284→```
   285→
   286→### Kod Stili
   287→
   288→- **TypeScript**: Strict mode aktif
   289→- **ESLint**: Next.js recommended kurallar

1→/**
     2→ * QR Code Generator Utility
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides QR code generation functionality for the e-menum.net
     5→ * platform. It supports multiple output formats: SVG, PNG (at various sizes),
     6→ * and A5 PDF for printing.
     7→ *
     8→ * Key Features:

1→/**
     2→ * Bulk QR Code Download Utility
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides bulk download functionality for multiple QR codes.
     5→ * It supports downloading all table QR codes as either a ZIP file or a
     6→ * combined PDF document.
     7→ *
     8→ * Key Features:
     9→ * - ZIP format with individual PNG files (2048px) for each table
    10→ * - Combined PDF format with all tables on separate A5 pages
    11→ * - Browser-based file generation and download
    12→ * - Progress tracking for large batches
    13→ * - Error handling for failed QR generations
    14→ *
    15→ * @example
    16→ * // Download all tables as ZIP
    17→ * const result = await downloadAllTablesAsZip(tables, organizationSlug, organizationName)
    18→ * if (!result.success) {
    19→ *   toast.error(result.error)
    20→ * }
    21→ *
    22→ * // Download all tables as combined PDF
    23→ * const result = await downloadAllTablesAsPDF(tables, organizationSlug, organizationName)
    24→ */
    25→
    26→import JSZip from 'jszip'
    27→import { generateQRCodePNG, generateQRCodePDF } from './generator'
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Table data structure for bulk operations
    31→ */
    32→export interface TableForBulkDownload {
    33→  qr_uuid: string
    34→  table_number: string
    35→}
    36→
    37→/**
    38→ * Result of a bulk download operation
    39→ */
    40→export interface BulkDownloadResult {
    41→  /** Whether the operation succeeded */
    42→  success: boolean
    43→  /** Number of QR codes successfully generated */
    44→  successCount: number
    45→  /** Number of QR codes that failed */
    46→  failureCount: number
    47→  /** Total number of tables processed */
    48→  totalCount: number
    49→  /** Error message if operation failed */
    50→  error?: string
    51→  /** Detailed errors for individual failures */
    52→  failures?: Array<{
    53→    tableNumber: string
    54→    error: string
    55→  }>
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Download all table QR codes as a ZIP file.
    60→ *
    61→ * Creates a ZIP archive containing individual PNG files (2048px) for each
    62→ * table's QR code. The ZIP is generated in the browser and automatically
    63→ * downloaded.
    64→ *
    65→ * File naming pattern inside ZIP:
    66→ * - Individual files: `{table-number}-qr.png`
    67→ * - ZIP filename: `{org-slug}-tables-qr-{timestamp}.zip`
    68→ *
    69→ * @param tables - Array of tables with qr_uuid and table_number
    70→ * @param organizationSlug - Organization's slug for menu URLs
    71→ * @param organizationName - Organization's name for display
    72→ * @returns Promise<BulkDownloadResult> - Result of the bulk operation
    73→ *
    74→ * @example
    75→ * ```typescript
    76→ * const tables = await fetchTables()
    77→ * const result = await downloadAllTablesAsZip(tables, 'my-restaurant', 'My Restaurant')
    78→ * if (result.success) {
    79→ *   toast.success(`${result.successCount} QR kodları indirildi`)
    80→ * } else {
    81→ *   toast.error(result.error)
    82→ * }
    83→ * ```
    84→ */
    85→export async function downloadAllTablesAsZip(
    86→  tables: TableForBulkDownload[],
    87→  organizationSlug: string,
    88→  organizationName: string
    89→): Promise<BulkDownloadResult> {
    90→  if (!organizationSlug) {
    91→    return {
    92→      success: false,
    93→      successCount: 0,
    94→      failureCount: 0,
    95→      totalCount: 0,
    96→      error: 'Organizasyon slug değeri gereklidir',
    97→    }
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  if (!tables || tables.length === 0) {
   101→    return {
   102→      success: false,
   103→      successCount: 0,
   104→      failureCount: 0,
   105→      totalCount: 0,
   106→      error: 'İndirilecek masa bulunamadı',
   107→    }
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  const zip = new JSZip()
   111→  let successCount = 0
   112→  let failureCount = 0
   113→  const failures: Array<{ tableNumber: string; error: string }> = []
   114→
   115→  // Generate QR codes for all tables
   116→  for (const table of tables) {
   117→    try {
   118→      // Generate PNG at 2048px for good quality
   119→      const result = await generateQRCodePNG(organizationSlug, 2048, table.qr_uuid)
   120→
   121→      if (!result.success || !result.data) {
   122→        failureCount++
   123→        failures.push({
   124→          tableNumber: table.table_number,
   125→          error: result.error || 'QR kodu oluşturulamadı',
   126→        })
   127→        continue
   128→      }
   129→
   130→      // Convert data URL to blob data

1→# Manual Testing Guide: Bulk QR Code Download Feature
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→This guide provides detailed instructions for manually testing the bulk QR code download feature for tables.
     5→
     6→## Prerequisites
     7→1. Ensure the development server is running: `npm run dev`
     8→2. Navigate to `http://localhost:3000/tables` in your browser
     9→3. You should have an active session with access to a restaurant/organization
    10→4. You should have the JSZip dependency installed: `npm install`
    11→
    12→## Test Cases
    13→
    14→### Test Case 1: Normal Operation with Multiple Tables (Happy Path)
    15→**Objective:** Verify that bulk download works correctly with multiple tables
    16→
    17→**Steps:**
    18→1. Navigate to `/tables` page
    19→2. Ensure you have at least 3-5 tables in the system
    20→   - If not, create some test tables first
    21→3. Locate the "Download All" button near the "New Table" button in the page header
    22→4. Click the "Download All" button
    23→5. Verify that a dropdown menu appears with two options:
    24→   - "Download All as ZIP"
    25→   - "Download All as PDF"
    26→
    27→**Test 1A: Download All as ZIP**
    28→1. Click "Download All as ZIP"
    29→2. Wait for the download to complete
    30→3. Verify that a ZIP file downloads with filename pattern: `{org-slug}-tables-qr-YYYY-MM-DD.zip`
    31→4. Extract the ZIP file
    32→5. Verify:
    33→   - ✅ Each table has a corresponding PNG file inside
    34→   - ✅ PNG filenames follow pattern: `{table-number}-qr.png`
    35→   - ✅ PNG files are high quality (2048px)
    36→   - ✅ Each PNG contains a valid QR code
    37→   - ✅ Number of PNG files matches number of tables
    38→
    39→**Test 1B: Download All as PDF**
    40→1. Click "Download All as PDF"
    41→2. Wait for the download to complete
    42→3. Verify that a ZIP file downloads with filename pattern: `{org-slug}-tables-qr-pdf-YYYY-MM-DD.zip`
    43→4. Extract the ZIP file
    44→5. Verify:
    45→   - ✅ Each table has a corresponding PDF file inside
    46→   - ✅ PDF filenames follow pattern: `{table-number}-qr.pdf`
    47→   - ✅ Each PDF is A5 size with QR code
    48→   - ✅ Each PDF includes organization name and table number
    49→   - ✅ Number of PDF files matches number of tables
    50→
    51→### Test Case 2: Edge Case - No Tables
    52→**Objective:** Verify error handling when no tables exist
    53→
    54→**Steps:**
    55→1. Delete all tables or switch to an organization with no tables
    56→2. Navigate to `/tables` page
    57→3. Click "Download All" button
    58→4. Select "Download All as ZIP"
    59→5. Verify:
    60→   - ✅ An error message appears (e.g., "İndirilecek masa bulunamadı")
    61→   - ✅ No ZIP file is downloaded
    62→   - ✅ The error is user-friendly and clear
    63→
    64→6. Repeat with "Download All as PDF"
    65→7. Verify same error handling behavior
    66→
    67→### Test Case 3: Edge Case - Single Table
    68→**Objective:** Verify that bulk download works correctly with just one table
    69→
    70→**Steps:**
    71→1. Ensure you have exactly 1 table in the system
    72→2. Navigate to `/tables` page
    73→3. Click "Download All" → "Download All as ZIP"
    74→4. Verify:
    75→   - ✅ ZIP file downloads successfully
    76→   - ✅ ZIP contains exactly 1 PNG file
    77→   - ✅ PNG is valid and contains correct QR code
    78→
    79→### Test Case 4: Edge Case - Many Tables (10+)
    80→**Objective:** Verify performance with many tables
    81→
    82→**Steps:**
    83→1. Create 10-15 test tables
    84→2. Navigate to `/tables` page
    85→3. Click "Download All" → "Download All as ZIP"
    86→4. Verify:
    87→   - ✅ Download starts within reasonable time (< 3 seconds)
    88→   - ✅ All QR codes are generated correctly
    89→   - ✅ ZIP contains all tables
    90→   - ✅ No browser console errors
    91→   - ✅ UI remains responsive during generation
    92→
    93→### Test Case 5: Error Handling - QR Generation Failure
    94→**Objective:** Verify graceful error handling when QR generation fails
    95→
    96→**Steps:**
    97→1. Open browser DevTools console
    98→2. Navigate to `/tables` page
    99→3. Monitor console for errors during bulk download
   100→4. If possible, simulate a network error or invalid QR data
   101→5. Verify:
   102→   - ✅ Error messages are displayed to the user
   103→   - ✅ Partial success is handled (some QRs succeed, some fail)
   104→   - ✅ The browser doesn't crash or hang
   105→   - ✅ Error details are logged appropriately
   106→
   107→### Test Case 6: UI/UX Verification
   108→**Objective:** Verify the user interface and experience
   109→
   110→**Steps:**
   111→1. Navigate to `/tables` page
   112→2. Verify the "Download All" button:
   113→   - ✅ Is visible and properly positioned near "New Table" button
   114→   - ✅ Has appropriate styling consistent with the page design
   115→   - ✅ Dropdown menu is styled correctly
   116→   - ✅ Hover states work properly
   117→   - ✅ Dark mode styling is correct (if dark mode is enabled)
   118→   - ✅ Icons and text are aligned properly
   119→   - ✅ Dropdown closes when clicking outside
   120→
   121→### Test Case 7: Browser Compatibility
   122→**Objective:** Verify feature works across different browsers
   123→
   124→**Test in each browser:**
   125→- Chrome/Edge (Chromium)
   126→- Firefox
   127→- Safari (if on macOS)
   128→
   129→**For each browser:**
   130→1. Navigate to `/tables` page
   131→2. Test "Download All as ZIP"
   132→3. Test "Download All as PDF"
   133→4. Verify:
   134→   - ✅ Downloads work correctly
   135→   - ✅ No console errors
   136→   - ✅ UI renders correctly
   137→   - ✅ Files can be extracted and opened
   138→
   139→### Test Case 8: File Naming Validation
   140→**Objective:** Verify filename sanitization works correctly
   141→
   142→**Steps:**
   143→1. Create tables with special characters in names:
   144→   - "Masa 1" (with space)
   145→   - "VIP!" (with exclamation)
   146→   - "Teras #5" (with hash)
   147→   - "BAR/Lounge" (with slash)
   148→2. Download all as ZIP
   149→3. Extract and verify:
   150→   - ✅ Filenames are sanitized (e.g., "masa-1-qr.png")
   151→   - ✅ Special characters are removed or replaced with hyphens
   152→   - ✅ Files can be extracted without errors
   153→   - ✅ No duplicate filenames
   154→
   155→## Console Error Checks
   156→
   157→Throughout all tests, monitor the browser console for:
   158→- ❌ TypeScript errors
   159→- ❌ Runtime errors
   160→- ❌ Network errors
   161→- ❌ Warning messages
   162→- ❌ Failed QR generation attempts
   163→
   164→All tests should complete WITHOUT console errors.
   165→
   166→## Success Criteria
   167→
   168→The feature is considered **PASSING** if:
   169→- ✅ All 8 test cases pass
   170→- ✅ No console errors appear during testing
   171→- ✅ Files download with correct naming patterns
   172→- ✅ QR codes are valid and scannable
   173→- ✅ Error handling works gracefully
   174→- ✅ UI is polished and responsive
   175→- ✅ Feature works across major browsers
   176→
   177→## Failure Criteria
   178→
   179→The feature is considered **FAILING** if:
   180→- ❌ Downloads don't work
   181→- ❌ QR codes are invalid or don't scan
   182→- ❌ Console errors appear
   183→- ❌ File naming is incorrect
   184→- ❌ Error messages are unclear or missing
   185→- ❌ UI is broken or misaligned
   186→- ❌ Browser crashes or hangs
   187→
   188→## Testing Checklist
   189→
   190→Use this checklist to track your testing progress:
   191→
   192→- [ ] Test Case 1A: ZIP download with multiple tables
   193→- [ ] Test Case 1B: PDF download with multiple tables
   194→- [ ] Test Case 2: No tables error handling
   195→- [ ] Test Case 3: Single table download
   196→- [ ] Test Case 4: Many tables (10+) download
   197→- [ ] Test Case 5: Error handling verification

   199→- [ ] Test Case 7: Browser compatibility (Chrome)

1→/**
     2→ * Bulk QR Code Download Utility
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides bulk download functionality for multiple QR codes.
     5→ * It supports downloading all table QR codes as either a ZIP file or a
     6→ * combined PDF document.
     7→ *
     8→ * Key Features:
     9→ * - ZIP format with individual PNG files (2048px) for each table
    10→ * - Combined PDF format with all tables on separate A5 pages
    11→ * - Browser-based file generation and download
    12→ * - Progress tracking for large batches
    13→ * - Error handling for failed QR generations
    14→ *
    15→ * @example
    16→ * // Download all tables as ZIP
    17→ * const result = await downloadAllTablesAsZip(tables, organizationSlug, organizationName)
    18→ * if (!result.success) {
    19→ *   toast.error(result.error)
    20→ * }
    21→ *
    22→ * // Download all tables as combined PDF
    23→ * const result = await downloadAllTablesAsPDF(tables, organizationSlug, organizationName)
    24→ */
    25→
    26→import JSZip from 'jszip'
    27→import { generateQRCodePNG, generateQRCodePDF } from './generator'
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Table data structure for bulk operations
    31→ */
    32→export interface TableForBulkDownload {
    33→  qr_uuid: string
    34→  table_number: string
    35→}
    36→
    37→/**
    38→ * Result of a bulk download operation
